description: Not affiliated with the U.S. government, GSA, or SAM.gov. Not a U.S. government service. Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation solicitations posted to SAM.gov under CORHQ numbers. FDIC buys mostly IT infrastructure, application services, and bank resolution support. FDIC is not FAR-bound and does not report awards to FPDS, so award history is limited to what SAM.gov publishes. Filter by keyword. Present as information only; verify every fact against the official notice before acting. One search counts as one use, regardless of how many records are returned. Every record carries a direct source link (or source name and record ID) so you can verify and cite the underlying record.
